newsitem.title: GERMANY: Swastikas daubed on wall in German arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Swastikas daubed on wall in German arson attack.

text.p: Unidentified attackers set fire to church property in northern Germany overnight and sprayed Nazi swastikas on a wall, police said on Sunday.
They said the assailants set fire to a kindergarten next to the church in the city of Luebeck. The fire caused some damage but no one was injured.
Firemen extinguished the blaze within 30 minutes.
Police also found a slogan threatening a local priest sprayed on the front of the building. The priest is a campaigner against the deportation of Algerian asylum-seekers.
Several churches in northern Germany have been the targets of arson attacks in recent weeks.
Police detained a man earlier this month in connection with an attack which destroyed another Luebeck church. Swastikas and the priest's name were also sprayed on a wall.
In the latest incident, the kindergarten was part of a parish complex. The church itself was not damaged.
